bootstrap_note: Each high-confidence device's usable flows were resampled with replacement (same count), fingerprints recomputed with 05_profile_devices.build_fingerprints, rescaled with the scaler fitted above, and re-clustered with Ward. Caveat: duplicated flows add zero inter-flow gaps (inflating gap_cv) and cannot add new peers (deflating log_distinct_peers), so ARI is a conservative estimate.
